question: Which among the following rivers does not flow into the Bay of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tapti.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tapti River:-**

 
 
• ​The Tapti River originates from the **Satpura Range in Madhya Pradesh** and flows through **Maharashtra and Gujarat **before draining into the Arabian Sea. 
 
• It is the **third-longest river** in peninsular India.
 
• **It does not flow into the Bay of Bengal.**
 
• It drains into the Arabian Sea
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna River: **

 
 
• It originates from the **Western Ghats** and flows through the states of **Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh **before draining into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Yamuna River:**
 
 
• It flows through the states of **Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi, and Uttar Pradesh** before draining into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Mahanadi River:**
 
 
• It originates from the **Chhattisgarh hills** and flows through the states of **Chhattisgarh and Odisha** before draining into the Bay of Bengal.
